legend.Mainnet: adapter deployed on X Layer mainnet and exercised there with real transactions
legend.Fork-tested: adapter deployed on X Layer mainnet; behaviour proven by fork tests against live chain state
legend.Agent-only: agents are checked; the wallet's own owner key or keys are not
legend.Partial: pre-execution checks work, with a known way to remove the hook or skip the timelock

fields.agentOnly: only agents are checked, not the wallet's own owner key or keys
fields.isBound: FengceBinding.isBound can return true for this wallet
